name: Balsa UI
summary: Agent-native open-code UI for React and Vue — CLI copies editable source you own.
gaps: Pilot includes 12 React comps — catalog-index.json currently lists frameworks:['vue'] only; React registries live at /r/react/{slug}.json (verified HTTP 200).
Default /r/{slug}.json is Vue (shadcn-vue schema); React path /r/react/{slug}.json required for React ownership.
Site is client-rendered SPA; iframe demos rely on JS hydration.
npm package description/keywords still Vue-first; README documents React 19 (~99 items) alongside Vue 3.
iframe demos only; no dynamic-import smoke mounts in this packet.

components.name: Button
components.summary: Typed action control with solid/soft/outline/glass variants and FAB shapes.

demo.peerNotes: CLI also installs Vue; catalog uses React registry /r/react/{slug}.json

components.copyCode:
npx balsa-ui@latest add button

# React registry (explicit):
# npx shadcn@latest add https://balsa-ui.com/r/react/button.json
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/Button"

<Button />

copyPrompt.text: Use Balsa UI free MIT React component `Button` (slug `button`) from https://balsa-ui.com/docs/components/button. Install with `npx balsa-ui@latest add button` (CLI detects React vs Vue) or `npx shadcn@latest add https://balsa-ui.com/r/react/button.json`. React registry item: https://balsa-ui.com/r/react/button.json (Vue default registry is https://balsa-ui.com/r/button.json — do not use for React). Imports land under `src/components/ui/Button.tsx`. Requires React 19 + Tailwind. License: MIT (https://raw.githubusercontent.com/pedrobalsa/balsa-ui/main/LICENSE; Copyright (c) 2026 Balsa UI contributors). Pricing free.
